upper_bound_note: all PIT-sliced tickers; the engine screens the screenable subset
generator:
"""B3139q-r121 (S6-B1250-ENG11-POOL-PANEL-PERF): the pool path's DISCARDED
panel pre-pass, timed on the Step-2 universe. screen_universe (screener.py)
builds close_panel and runs compute_panel_signals_for_as_of in the MAIN
process every screen day; on the pool path the work items never carry the
result, and the workers recompute those indicators. This times exactly that
block - the close_panel build plus the panel call - on the engine's own
inputs: the phase table's Step-2 universe (output_audit/r5_universe_544.txt),
loaded from DATA_LOAD_START like BacktestEngine.load_data, sliced to as_of
like _pit_and_screenable (>= 30 bars). The engine screens the screenable
SUBSET of that dict, so this is an UPPER BOUND per day. Three as_of dates
spanning the Step-2 window, three repetitions each (median), run with no other
CPU-heavy process (L621). Read-only: writes one JSON to the path given."""
import json
import statistics
import sys
import time
from datetime import date
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd

ROOT = Path(r"C:\Users\jeetm\Github\stock-picks-app")
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
from backtest.config import DATA_LOAD_START  # noqa: E402
from backtest.data.cache import get_ohlcv_bulk  # noqa: E402
from backtest.signals.technical_panel import compute_panel_signals_for_as_of  # noqa: E402

out_path = Path(sys.argv[1])
tickers = [t.strip() for t in (ROOT / "output_audit" / "r5_universe_544.txt")
           .read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines() if t.strip()]
assert len(tickers) == 544, len(tickers)
t0 = time.perf_counter()
ohlcv = get_ohlcv_bulk(tickers, start=DATA_LOAD_START, end=date(2026, 5, 5))
load_s = time.perf_counter() - t0
print(f"loaded {len(ohlcv)} of {len(tickers)} tickers in {load_s:.1f}s")
res = []
for as_of in (date(2022, 6, 1), date(2024, 5, 1), date(2026, 4, 30)):
    pit = {}
    for t, df in ohlcv.items():
        if df is None:
            continue
        s = df[df.index.date <= as_of]
        if len(s) >= 30:
            pit[t] = s
    reps = []
    for _ in range(3):
        a = time.perf_counter()
        close_series = {t: df["close"] for t, df in pit.items()
                        if df is not None and "close" in df.columns and not df.empty}
        close_panel = pd.DataFrame(close_series)
        out = compute_panel_signals_for_as_of(close_panel)
        reps.append(time.perf_counter() - a)
    rec = {"as_of": str(as_of), "tickers_in_pit": len(pit), "panel_rows": int(close_panel.shape[0]),
           "panel_cols": int(close_panel.shape[1]), "tickers_with_signals": len(out),
           "reps_s": [round(x, 4) for x in reps], "median_s": round(statistics.median(reps), 4)}
    res.append(rec)
    print(rec)
rec = {"ticket": "S6-B1250-ENG11-POOL-PANEL-PERF (B3139q-r121)",
       "question": "the pool path's discarded main-process panel pre-pass, as a share of a Step-2 sim-day",
       "universe": "output_audit/r5_universe_544.txt (phase_table step 2)",
       "load_start": str(DATA_LOAD_START), "load_s": round(load_s, 1),
       "upper_bound_note": "all PIT-sliced tickers; the engine screens the screenable subset",
       "prepass": res,
       "generator": Path(__file__).read_text(encoding="utf-8")}
out_path.write_text(json.dumps(rec, indent=1), encoding="utf-8")
print("wrote", out_path)
